name: WhatsApp via Green-API
description: Deschil WhatsApp channel using Green-API (GREEN_API_INS + GREEN_API_TOK) for cloud-hosted message delivery.

instanceId.description: Green-API instance ID. Falls back to GREEN_API_INS environment variable.

token.description: Green-API token. Falls back to GREEN_API_TOK environment variable.

webhookPath.description: Gateway-relative path for the Green-API webhook receiver.

ownerNumber.description: E164 owner phone number. Only messages from this number are processed. Defaults to DESCHIL_OWNER_NUMBER env var.
